summary: Iteration 171 - Three new features tested: Future-Date Rate Parity Heatmap, Morning Brief / 8AM digest, and Pricing Autopilot config + run-now. All backend APIs (18/18 tests passed) and frontend UI flows verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: All three new features implemented correctly with proper data-testid attributes
Parity Heatmap: GET /api/parity/heatmap/{property_id}?days=N returns property_id, base_rate, days, cells[], summary{avg_delta_pct,underpriced_days,parity_days,overpriced_days,no_data_days} - VERIFIED
Each heatmap cell contains: date, dow, is_weekend, our_rate, comp_avg, comp_min, comp_max, comp_count, competitors[], delta_pct, class, occ_pct - VERIFIED
Days parameter correctly clamped to 7-180 range - VERIFIED

Morning Brief: GET /api/morning-brief/{property_id} returns today{arrivals,departures,in_house}, pickup_7d{count,revenue}, stly_7d{ty_rooms,ly_rooms,delta,delta_pct}, alerts{open_logbook,unread_inbox,unanswered_reviews}, new_reviews[] - VERIFIED
Autopilot GET: Returns default config {enabled:false, schedule, days_window, auto_apply, last_run_at, last_summary, last_recommendations[]} - VERIFIED
Autopilot POST: Upserts config with enabled, schedule, days_window, auto_apply - VERIFIED
Autopilot run-now: POST /api/autopilot/pricing/{property_id}/run-now stamps last_run_at - VERIFIED
Autopilot save-run: POST /api/autopilot/pricing/{property_id}/save-run persists recommendations and summary - VERIFIED
Frontend: parity-heatmap-btn, morning-brief-btn menu items working
Frontend: parity-heatmap-panel, parity-summary, parity-grid, parity-days-{30,60,90,180}, parity-cell-{date}, parity-detail all working
Frontend: morning-brief-panel, brief-today, brief-stly, brief-alerts, brief-autopilot all working
Frontend: autopilot-toggle, autopilot-days-window, autopilot-schedule, autopilot-auto-apply, autopilot-run-now all working
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features (Parity Heatmap, Morning Brief, Pricing Autopilot) are fully functional. The heatmap shows many 'no_data' cells (91 out of 180 days) because competitor scrape data is sparse - this is expected behavior. The autopilot Run Now button triggers 3 sequential API calls: /run-now → /ai-v2/recommend → /save-run. LLM may be budget-capped but save-run still succeeds. Regression tests for iter 170 features (Pace Reports, AI Pricing V2, Unified Inbox) all passed.
